description: This file implements a React component for a draggable block menu in a rich text editor built with Lexical. It manages drag-and-drop interactions for blocks within the editor, including visual indicators and positioning logic.

methods.name: getCurrentIndex
methods.description: Calculates the current index in the block list based on previous index or middle position.

methods.name: getTopLevelNodeKeys
methods.description: Retrieves all top-level node keys from the Lexical editor state.

methods.name: elementContainingEventLocation
methods.description: Determines if an event location is within a given element, considering its children recursively.

methods.name: getBlockElement
methods.description: Finds the block element at a given event location by scanning top-level nodes.

methods.name: isOnMenu
methods.description: Checks if an element is within the draggable block menu.

methods.name: setMenuPosition
methods.description: Positions the draggable menu relative to a target element.

methods.name: setDragImage
methods.description: Sets a custom drag image for the drag event.

methods.name: setTargetLine
methods.description: Positions the line indicating where the block will be inserted.

methods.name: hideTargetLine
methods.description: Hides the insertion target line indicator.

methods.name: useDraggableBlockMenu
methods.description: React hook that manages the draggable block menu UI and interactions.

methods.name: DraggableBlockPlugin
methods.description: Main React component that integrates the draggable block menu with the editor context.
